create_gumbel_vector_quantizer: create a GumbelVectorQuantizer module with specified dim, num_vars, temperature, groups, and vq_dim parameters
run_forward_quantization: run forward pass through GumbelVectorQuantizer to quantize input tensor using gumbel softmax sampling
sample_from_codebook: sample random vectors from the quantizer codebook using sample_from_codebook with batch and sample size
get_codebook_indices: get the flattened codebook indices tensor for all group combinations in the vector quantizer
set_temperature_updates: set the current temperature for gumbel softmax based on number of training updates with decay
